caption: The drawing depicts the carved figure of a person, shown from the front and slightly angled to the left. The figure appears to be made of a dark green or patinated metal or wood, with detailed features including long hair, a muscular torso, and a stern facial expression. The person is holding a round shield with a circular pattern on it in their left hand, which is positioned in front of their body. The right arm is bent and held close to the body. The lower section of the sculpture tapers and integrates into a stylized, scroll-like ornament painted in yellow and orange tones, with leafy extensions. To the right side of the image, behind the main figure, are faint sketches and outlines that suggest additional decorative elements, with some partially colored in yellow and the rest left as pencil sketches. The background is plain and off-white, highlighting the central figure and ornamental details.
title: Figurehead
